title: Hire an AI agent in one minute

cues.text: Hire an AI teammate in under a minute.
Open Agents, choose Hire an agent, pick a role, name it and choose its model.
Then hand it a card from your board. It works in your repository and opens a pull request.
You can pause it, resume it or switch its model whenever you like.
You stay in charge of what ships. Try it with your own team.
Guildwise HQ is open source. Find the link in the description.
